title: Deleting an *.enc vault leaves an non interactive entry in the widget: Buttons to relocate / delete required
line: A vault whose encrypted folder is gone can now be deleted from the Vaults widget through Configure Vault.
explanation: VaultItem.qml set the whole list item to disabled when the vault's status was DeviceMissing or Error, so its expand arrow and every action, including Configure Vault (which holds the Delete page), were dead. Even when called directly, kded's deletion failed: the overlap check resolved the missing folder to "/" and saw it overlapping every other vault, and KIO::del would fail on the missing path. The item now stays enabled with only the unlock/lock actions disabled, the overlap check falls back to the cleaned path when the folder doesn't exist, and the FUSE backend only deletes the data and mount point folders that still exist.

commits.message:
applet, kded: allow deleting vaults whose encrypted folder is missing

Such vaults were shown disabled, so Configure Vault and its Delete page
were unreachable, and kded refused to delete them anyway. Keep Configure
available for them and make deletion skip paths that no longer exist.

BUG: 425043

media.caption: Master: the 'Gone' vault (its Gone.enc folder deleted) is greyed out; the expand arrow and clicks do nothing.
Fixed: the entry expands and offers Configure Vault…; unlocking stays disabled.
Master: asking kded to delete it directly (D-Bus deleteVault) fails with 'overlapping paths' when another vault exists.
Fixed: after Configure Vault → Delete, 'Gone' is removed and only 'Keep' remains.
